title: Election for class representative at Suryodaya School
body: In Grade 8 of Suryodaya School, three students, Ahmed, Gurmat and Ravi, contested the election for Class Representative. Ahmed promised cleaner classrooms and playground, Gurmat proposed peer coaching, and Ravi wanted more time for the arts. The class teacher, Ms. Usha, was the Election Officer. She explained the rules, told the class that voting would be by secret ballot, and set up a voting booth in a corner of the classroom. Each student received a ballot paper with the three names and marked an 'X' next to one name. Ms. Usha arranged a braille ballot paper for Neha. The ballots were collected in a box, which was sealed until counting. A teacher from the next class, Ms. Sheeba, was called to witness the counting. In all, 33 votes were cast. One ballot paper was not marked and was declared invalid. Ahmed received 8 votes, Gurmat 12 and Ravi 10. Gurmat was declared the new Class Representative, and Ahmed and Ravi congratulated her and offered their support.

title: Results in Constituency X
body: In a Lok Sabha constituency, four candidates contested the general election. Out of 10,00,000 valid votes, Candidate P received 3,80,000 votes, Candidate Q received 3,50,000 votes, Candidate R received 2,40,000 votes and Candidate S received 30,000 votes. Across the country, Party Alpha won 250 of the 543 Lok Sabha seats, Party Beta won 60 seats and Party Gamma won 140 seats; the remaining seats were won by other parties and independents. After the results, Party Alpha and Party Beta agreed to work together as a coalition.
